name: faf001_StartTask
description: Start an assigned open task and its linked human-task step using optimistic concurrency. Sets the task In Progress and the step Running.

CustomAPIRequestParameters.name: faf001_StartTask.faf001_TaskId
CustomAPIRequestParameters.description: Required nonempty task GUID. The task must be assigned to the Dataverse caller.

CustomAPIResponseProperties.name: faf001_StartTask.faf001_TaskId
CustomAPIResponseProperties.description: Started task GUID. An In Progress task with a Running linked step is unchanged.
